title: mentha longifolia var. bacsensis
intro: Mentha longifolia var. bacsensis, commonly known as Vietnamese mint or Bac Ha mint, is a variant of the Mentha longifolia species, a type of mint plant native to Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Mentha longifolia var. bacsensis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils such as menthone, limonene, and linalool, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects.
